Appreciate the quick note. Short answers up front:

(a) Proof of authority: I attached a one-page confirmation signed by our Legal Ops (Execution_Checklist_CONNOR_v1.md) and we can also include a scanned Delegation of Authority if you prefer. (b) Witness vs notarization: We typically accept a DocuSign witness field for commercial Order Forms and MSA addenda. Plan I propose:
- Send a sequential DocuSign envelope: GreenLeaf signer -> Redwood CFO (Rishi) -> Witness (if requested).
- Include the attached Execution Checklist and the scanned POA as envelope documents.
- Add a DocuSign note field with signatory role/title for audit.
